messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: routing-service detected high error-rate + fallback churn for customer-facing requests in eu-west-1. Paging alice (oncall).

alice (oncall): seeing 500 spikes and lots of 'model-variant mismatch' traces. Customers reporting degraded completions. Investigating.

bob: grabbing it. can you drop a sample trace id?

alice (oncall): trace 9f3b2c7 - repeated region-fallback attempt between eu-west-1 and eu-central-1, then a model variant fallback to tiny-quant which is incompatible with current prompt -> completions failing.

carol: looks like the new routing schema migration landed a change that removes explicit "preferred_variant" when a deprecated field is present. If validator returns default, runtime picks lowest-cost variant.

dave: pinging policy-service team. @policy-service any recent deploys?

policy-service: we rolled change 2024-11-02 03:10 UTC to config-validator: treat "legacy_fallback": true as deprecated. New behavior is to fallback to environment default unless explicit "fallback_policy" specified. We added a default-path to preserve compatibility but apparently default is wrong for some routes.

emily-cs: getting EM tickets from 3 enterprise customers in EU with increased error rate and incorrect short responses. One customer says transcripts cut off mid-sentence.

alice (oncall): temporary mitigation idea: disable cross-region fallback in runtime, force strict-local routing for affected customers, and pin their route to model-variant stable-large-v2. Can we do that quickly?

bob: I can push a targeted runtime toggle. Planning: (1) set router.allow_cross_region_fallback=false for namespace=prod-eu; (2) set route override for top 5 affected customers to variant=stable-large-v2; (3) roll back config-validator change if needed.

carol: config snippet that caused trouble (from deploy):
```yaml
# routing/policies/v2/customer_defaults.yaml
# note: legacy_fallback is deprecated
legacy_fallback: true
# we expected validator to translate this to fallback_policy: safe_fallback
# but validator dropped it, leaving runtime to use default -> cheap_variant
```

carol: new validator code (intentionally) maps deprecated fields to nothing and relies on explicit 'fallback_policy'. That was a mistake for routes that relied on implicit behavior.

dave: can we hotfix validator to map legacy_fallback->fallback_policy:safe_fallback while we ship a proper migration?

bob: I can hotfix runtime toggle now. hotfix plan command: `rbxctl runtime set --namespace prod-eu --key router.allow_cross_region_fallback --value false`

deploy-bot: deploy started by bob at 1742011200 for runtime-toggle-prod-eu.

alice (oncall): applying route pin overrides for affected customers (ids redacted). Doing one by one to limit blast radius.

policy-service: we will queue a validator rollback PR. tagging @carol and @dave for review.

bob: runtime toggle applied to 4/6 regions at 1742012100. Observability shows immediate drop in cross-region attempts. Error rate for EU customer A dropped from 6.8% -> 0.9% within 2 minutes.

alice (oncall): continuing rollout to remaining regions.

emily-cs: telling customers we found a routing policy regression due to a schema migration; mitigation in progress; ETA for full mitigation 30m. Customers appreciate proactive update. :thumbsup:

policy-service: rollback PR opened: Revert validator change and add compatibility mapping. PR #4237. Requesting urgent review.

carol: review complete. I will merge and request staged deploy to validator-canaries first. But I recommend keeping runtime cross-region disabled until validator fix is verified.

bob: excellent. I'll keep the runtime toggle for at least 1 hour post-deploy and then gradually re-enable with canary. Also keeping route pins for top-5 until config migration tooling runs.

deploy-bot: validator rollback deployed to canary at 1742013600. No errors in canary for 10m.

alice (oncall): passing on-call to dave for monitoring while I take a short break. Handoff: monitoring link, pinned messages, affected-customer list. dave please escalate if error rate rises above 1.5%.

dave: taking over. I'll watch metrics and CS queue. Thanks Alice.

emily-cs: opened incident postmortem ticket INC-2024-778 with customer impact summary and timeline. Will follow up with affected customers with root cause once we confirm revert.

policy-service: validator rollback merged to main. Scheduled deploy to prod 1742014200.

bob: runtime cross-region fallback re-enabled in 1 region to test after validator deploy. Observability shows correct mapping applied, no cheap-variant fallbacks observed.

dave: prod rollout of validator done at 1742014400. Monitoring window active. No regression for 15m. Reverting route pins and runtime toggle in 10m if stable.

dave: removing route pins for customers slowly. Removing router.allow_cross_region_fallback toggle in 10m.

incident-bot: ALERT: post-incident follow-up required. Please add timeline + remediation to incidents board.

emily-cs: drafting customer-facing explanation stating: schema migration removed implicit mapping for deprecated field, causing runtime to choose a cost-optimized fallback variant incompatible with some prompts. Action: rolled back validator change and applied temporary routing pins and regional restrictions. Long-term: we'll add compatibility mapping + test suites for routing migrations, add rollout guardrails.

alice (oncall): summary notes for postmortem (adding to thread): root cause = validator schema change dropped mapping for deprecated 'legacy_fallback' -> allowed runtime to default to cost-optimized variant; immediate mitigation = runtime toggle + route pins + validator rollback; follow-ups = add migration tests, add canary gating on policy mappings, produce customer RCA.

emily-cs: estimated impacted requests ~ 12k over 28 minutes across 3 enterprise customers; degraded completion quality and some 5xxs. No data exfiltration.

sre-rotations-bot: REMINDER: oncall Handoff completed. Next oncall: frank in 2h.

alice (oncall): thanks team. closing pager if no new alerts in next 45m. :white_check_mark: 

carol: filing a follow-up to add automated lint that disallows removing implicit compatibility mappings without an explicit migration opt-in.

bob: will document the runtime flag and emergency rollback playbook in runbook.

emily-cs: closing loop with customers, will keep them informed.

incident-bot: PAGER: no further alerts for 45m. Incident status -> mitigated.
